# CS Franddos Limited
> Premium travel, visa, passport, and international recruitment agency based in Ashiaman, Greater Accra, Ghana. Serving clients in 40+ countries since 2017.

## Pages

- [Home](https://csfranddos.com/): Company overview, featured destinations, client testimonials, services summary, FAQ
- [About](https://csfranddos.com/about/): Company history, mission, values, team milestones
- [Services](https://csfranddos.com/services/): Travel & tour packages, international job recruitment, visa applications, passport & document assistance
- [Destinations](https://csfranddos.com/destinations/): Travel guides for Paris, Dubai, London, Toronto, New York, and Amsterdam
- [Insights](https://csfranddos.com/insights/): Blog articles on travel tips, visa guides, and career advice
- [Contact](https://csfranddos.com/contact/): Contact form, office address, phone numbers, and email
- [Reviews](https://csfranddos.com/reviews/): Client video testimonials and reviews
- [Vacancies](https://csfranddos.com/vacancies/): Current job openings at CS Franddos

## Structured Data

This site uses JSON-LD structured data on every page:
- Organization schema (name, logo, contact info, address)
- LocalBusiness schema (services, hours, price range)
- FAQPage schema on the home page
- Article schema on each blog post
- BreadcrumbList schema on interior pages
